profile.name: Sai Kumar Gurugubelli
profile.title: Full-Stack Engineer & Backend Specialist
profile.bio: I'm a full-stack engineer with a strong backend focus, building scalable web applications and APIs used in real-world production environments. With a Master's in Information Technology from Griffith University (2024) and hands-on experience across the full software lifecycle — from system design to cloud deployment — I bring both technical depth and delivery discipline to every project.
profile.bio2: I actively use AI tools — Claude and GitHub Copilot — as core parts of my development workflow. Whether it's reviewing architecture decisions, generating test coverage, or integrating LLM-powered features into products, I know how to work with AI to ship faster and smarter. I care deeply about code quality, performance, and building systems that are maintainable at scale.
